title: Hanford identifies tank-space availability as a documented feed constraint
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Hanford Field Office
summary: The June TPA report records DFLAW Campaign 2 Batch 2 completion on February 25, a subsequent TSCR pause caused by limited space in Tank 241-AP-106, and creation of 100,000 gallons of space by transferring waste to WTP. Denominator: One named campaign and batch, one named receiving tank, one documented pause condition, and one 100,000-gallon space-creation action; the next processing batch remains planned rather than complete.
